title: How to choose a home nurse for your family in Qatar: 5 questions to ask
description: Before a nurse enters your home, these questions help you choose with confidence and peace of mind.
image_alt: Home nurse with the care team
body:
Choosing a nurse who will come into your home and care for a loved one is a big decision. To help you feel at ease from day one, here are the key questions to ask any home nursing provider.

## 1. Can I know the nurse before the visit?
You have the right to know who is entering your home. Ask for the nurse's name, experience and the languages she speaks before the first visit.

## 2. What exactly will the nurse do?
Ask for a clear list of tasks: medication follow-up per the doctor's prescription, vital signs, help with mobility and personal hygiene, and so on. Clarity from the start helps you and the patient.

## 3. How will I get updates on the patient?
If you are at work or away, you need to know what happened in each visit. Ask whether you get a report after every visit, and how.

## 4. Who do I contact if I need something?
A follow-up team that answers you in your language and handles any concern quickly makes a real difference.

## 5. Does the nurse follow the treating doctor's instructions?
A home nurse supports the doctor's plan; she does not change it. Make sure she follows the doctor's instructions and informs you of any change she notices.

> Tip: write your questions down before you call, and share any reports or doctor's instructions so the provider can match you with the right nurse.
